title: 验证卷 #7 · a number of（裸用，无 large/the）填空专项
topic: IELTS 话题语境变式（第七轮·逼出'裸 a number of → 复数'的输出）
goal: 连续两轮在选择题里把 bare 'a number of + 复数名词' 写成 has/is。本轮改用填空，必须亲手写出谓语；3 题专攻裸 a number of（输出型），2 题做 the/a-large 对照锚点。口诀：看到 the 想'数字'(is/has)，看到 a(large) 想'很多个'(are/have)。全对即过关。

questions.prompt: A number of students in this school ____ (be) interested in studying abroad.
questions.explanation: 裸 a number of = many + 复数名词 → 复数 are。没有 the，number 不是'那个数字'。

questions.prompt: A number of new courses ____ (add) to the programme since last term.
questions.explanation: 裸 a number of + 复数名词 → 复数 have；since last term 逼现在完成时，courses 被添加 → 被动：have been added。

questions.prompt: The number of applications received by the university ____ steadily over the past decade.
questions.explanation: 有 the → 主语核心是'那个数字'→ has。对照锚点：和裸 a number of（→ have）只差一个冠词，规则相反。

questions.prompt: A number of complaints about road noise ____ (come) in from nearby residents so far this week.
questions.explanation: 裸 a number of + 复数名词 → have；so far this week 逼现在完成时：have come。

questions.prompt: A large number of the graduates who finished last year ____ now working abroad.
questions.explanation: a large number of + 复数名词 → are。'of...'后的名词才是主语核心，仍是复数。
